projects.review: The Little Prince Among the Stars takes us on a journey through eight tiny planets inspired by the world of The Little Prince. Don't expect big challenges or action-packed gameplay: the real charm lies in wandering through its environments, discovering hidden corners, and soaking up its magical, nostalgic atmosphere. And here's the surprising part: this entire little universe was created in just 16 days with the help of AI. A simple experience with plenty of personality, and one that's definitely worth exploring, even if just for a few minutes.
